thread:
alisa: FYI after the RBAC refactor rolled to private cluster in eu-west, tenant-abc reported they can't reach the private control plane console as admins.
kevin: ack. any error logs from their side?
maria: they're getting 403s when trying to create admin sessions. Repro locally against a private cluster repro.
jordan: curious if this is a mapping change between 'admin' and 'superuser' roles during the refactor. Did we rename internal roles?
alisa: yes, we consolidated role names, mapping happened in the sync job. suspect the mapping table missed some tenant bindings.
kevin: can someone grab the RBAC-sync job logs and audit events for the tenant? quick commands:
```
kubectl --context=private-eu-west1 logs deploy/rbac-sync -n redwood-system --since=2h | grep tenant-abc
aws logs filter-log-events --log-group-name /redwood/private/eu-west/rbac-sync --filter-pattern "tenant-abc"
```
maria: pulled audit logs, audit-bot showing role.bind events but no 'grant' for admin for tenant-abc after the deploy:
```
2026-03-20T10:12:34Z INFO rbac-sync mapping applied tenant=tenant-abc old=admin_v1 new=admin_v2
2026-03-20T10:12:35Z WARN rbac-sync missing-binding tenant=tenant-abc principal=team-admins
```
audit-bot: We have KMS-decrypt errors correlated at 10:12:36Z for the service principal used by the sync job: "AccessDeniedException: decrypt access denied".
kevin: oh — KMS key policy change? That would block the sync job from materializing the new bindings. Did key rotation run during the window?
jordan: maintenance window note: key-rotation job executed at 10:10Z. Ops ticket #OP-448 shows rotation completed but didn't re-attach service account to key.
alisa: if sync can't decrypt stored binding payloads, it skips applying them. That explains missing admin binds.
maria: mitigation plan: 1) re-grant KMS:Decrypt to rbac-sync SA on the new key, 2) re-run the sync job for tenant-abc, 3) validate admin session creation.
kevin: agree. we'll also backfill audit entries and run a quick smoke across 10 random private tenants.
jordan: I'll open a PR to make rbac-sync more resilient: on KMS decrypt failure, queue a retry and emit a high-severity alert + background reconcile.
alisa: who can apply the KMS policy change now? kevin?
kevin: on it. applying policy change and then re-triggering sync. ETA ~15m.
deploy-bot: deploy noted: rbac-sync v2.1.4 -> v2.1.5 (hotfix) started at 2026-03-20T10:28:00Z by kevin.
kevin: hotfix applied, re-ran job for tenant-abc, can someone confirm admin can create session now?
maria: confirmed by tenant contact — admin session works. audit-bot shows new grant logs at 10:32:12Z.
audit-bot: Added entries: "2026-03-20T10:32:12Z GRANT role=admin principal=team-admins tenant=tenant-abc source=rbac-sync".
jordan: opening follow-up ticket to add an e2e test for KMS+rbac-sync and validate role name aliasing during refactors.
alisa: good. postmortem expected. add to incidents board and include timeline + KMS rotation checklist.
kevin: logging note — increase retention for private control plane audit logs to 90d for customers on Dedicated/Private until we finish the postmortem.
maria: will owner that ticket and draft the postmortem.
alisa: thanks everyone. closing the hot incident, continuing follow-up tasks in tickets. :thumbsup:
